title: BookVerse
subtitle: Reading & Serialized Story Publishing Platform
description: A full-stack platform for reading PDF/EPUB books and publishing serialized stories, with personal libraries, annotations, reviews, reading progress, offline access, challenges, recommendations, and text-to-speech. Authors get story editors, scheduled chapters, beta readers, analytics, newsletters, series and shared universes; readers get clubs, comments, reactions, polls, and following.
story: Built with Prisma (substantial schema and migrations), Firebase authentication, Cloudflare R2 storage, Resend email, Stripe and UddoktaPay payments, AI-powered writing/cover/illustration tools, plus extensive moderation and administration workflows.

title: Talukder Furniture
subtitle: Furniture Catalog & Commerce Platform
description: A TypeScript full-stack furniture catalog and commerce platform built around Talukder Furniture's home and office product range. Supports public shopping, product details, wishlists, store/contact pages, careers, and a substantial admin area for managing products, categories, sets, images, leads, and site content.
story: Built for Talukder Group of Industries — a React, Vite, and Tailwind client paired with a Node.js, Express, and Prisma backend.

title: LifeOS
subtitle: Offline-First Personal Productivity Suite
description: An intelligent, offline-first personal productivity and lifestyle management suite for Android. It unifies task planning, daily routines, habit formation, financial tracking, health metrics, and smart goal milestones into a single, cohesive dashboard.
story: Designed to help you organize and elevate every aspect of your daily life — built natively with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

title: TechWisdom Technologies
subtitle: Company Showcase Website
description: A company showcase website presenting TechWisdom Technologies' services, products, portfolio, case studies, blog, pricing, careers, gallery, contact information, and project demonstrations through a polished interface with interactive backgrounds, a technology globe, splash screen, chat button, and requirement assistant.
story: Includes structured project, product, blog, job-opening, and demo data, SEO components, responsive UI utilities, Vitest testing, and deployment configuration.

title: Talukder uPVC
subtitle: Product Catalogue & CMS Platform
description: A full-stack TypeScript platform for Talukder uPVC Fittings with a public product catalogue (category and product-detail pages), company and factory information, downloads, certifications, enquiries, and wishlists — supported by extensive branded, factory, and product imagery.
story: Its protected administration area handles authentication, products, categories, CMS content, media, enquiry management, bulk imports, dashboards, reporting, activity logs, and user management.

title: AHB Study Abroad
subtitle: Bilingual Study-Abroad Consultancy Platform
description: A full-stack, bilingual study-abroad consultancy platform offering destination guides, university information, services, IELTS resources, scholarship content, consultations, testimonials, and contact flows. Includes authentication, lead capture and course-registration forms, and a protected admin area for countries, universities, scholarships, English tests, announcements, visa approvals, testimonials, and leads.
story: Uses Prisma with schema and seed data, API routes, destination and university datasets, and extensive branded assets.

title: Cambry Study Abroad
subtitle: Bilingual Study-Abroad Consultancy Platform
description: A full-stack, bilingual study-abroad consultancy platform offering destination guides, university information, services, IELTS resources, scholarship content, consultations, testimonials, and contact flows. Includes authentication, lead capture and course-registration forms, and a protected admin area for countries, universities, scholarships, English tests, announcements, visa approvals, testimonials, and leads.
story: Uses Prisma with schema and seed data, API routes, destination and university datasets, and extensive branded assets.

title: Whiteboard Education
subtitle: World Class Aid — Educational Services Platform
description: A comprehensive educational-services platform supporting student journeys for exploring and comparing universities and courses, submitting applications, finding scholarships and housing, accessing language-preparation and visa resources, and receiving event and support information — alongside dedicated partner workflows and a broad administrative dashboard.
story: The repository includes Supabase migrations and notification functions, large university and course datasets with scraping/import utilities, operational documentation, Vitest tooling, and an MIT license.

title: VocabVault
subtitle: Vocabulary Learning Platform
description: A full-stack vocabulary-learning platform that guides learners through a structured 10-stage word-learning flow with listening, recall, writing, speaking, flashcards, daily words, progress analytics, streaks, achievements, challenges, notifications, and leaderboards. Deepgram and Gemini/Groq integrations power speech and AI-assisted activities.
story: Includes Stripe and manual mobile-payment flows, a substantial admin dashboard for users, words, security, feedback, notifications, and transactions, plus Playwright testing, Sentry monitoring, and operational/security documentation.

title: Authentic Aura
subtitle: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A polished personal portfolio website for Mujahid Raj, full-stack engineer and co-founder of TechWisdom Technologies. The site presents projects, services, career history, publications, certificates, testimonials, pricing, FAQs, a downloadable CV, and a contact panel.
story: Built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Framer Motion, with TanStack Query supporting application state and data handling.

title: TechWisdom Hub
subtitle: ERP & Operations Platform
description: A comprehensive ERP and operations platform with CRM lead pipelines, project and client portals, finance and invoicing, HR/payroll, tasks, meetings, messaging, reports, CMS, document management, AI assistance, workflows, audits, notifications, and KPI dashboards.
story: Also supports PWA behavior, Android packaging through Capacitor, and desktop builds through Electron.
